mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM student s WHERE s.id=#{studentId} AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deletion_request d WHERE d.student_id=s.id) FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT g.parent_user_id FROM guardianship g JOIN user_account u ON u.id=g.parent_user_id JOIN student s ON s.id=g.student_id WHERE g.student_id=#{studentId} AND g.status='LINKED' AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.role='PARENT'

SELECT s.id, s.nickname, s.grade, s.birth_year FROM student s JOIN guardianship g ON g.student_id=s.id WHERE g.parent_user_id=#{userId} AND g.status='LINKED' AND s.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY g.linked_at, s.id
SELECT count(*) FROM guardianship WHERE parent_user_id=#{userId} AND status='LINKED'
